description: This file implements an Android notification listener service that tracks and manages device notifications, including handling notification lifecycle events, serializing notification data, and performing actions like opening, dismissing, or replying to notifications.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationEntry
classes.description: Represents a notification captured from the system with relevant properties such as key, package, title, text, category, post time, and flags like ongoing or clearable.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationSnapshot
classes.description: A snapshot of current device notifications including whether notifications are enabled and connected, and a list of notification entries.

classes.name: NotificationActionRequest
classes.description: Defines a request to perform an action on a notification, such as open, dismiss, or reply, including optional reply text.

classes.name: NotificationActionResult
classes.description: Represents the result of executing an action on a notification, indicating success, failure, and associated messages or codes.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService
classes.description: A Kotlin class extending NotificationListenerService that manages notification lifecycle events, storing, serializing, and performing actions on notifications.

methods.name: sanitizeNotificationText
methods.description: Cleans and truncates notification text to prevent overly long content.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationEntry.toJsonObject
methods.description: Serializes a notification entry into a JSON object for external communication or storage.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationEntry
methods.description: Constructors and data class for notification entries.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationSnapshot
methods.description: Constructors and data class for the notification snapshot state.

methods.name: NotificationActionRequest
methods.description: Constructs requests for notification actions.

methods.name: NotificationActionResult
methods.description: Constructs results for notification actions.

methods.name: actionRequiresClearableNotification
methods.description: Determines if an action requires the notification to be clearable (dismissible).

methods.name: DeviceNotificationStore.replace
methods.description: Replaces the current stored notifications with a new list.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationStore.upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates a notification entry in the store.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationStore.remove
methods.description: Removes a notification entry from the store by key.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationStore.setConnected
methods.description: Sets the connection status and clears notifications if disconnected.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationStore.snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of current notification state.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onListenerConnected
methods.description: Handles setup when the notification listener service connects.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onListenerDisconnected
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the service is disconnected.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up service resources on destruction.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onNotificationPosted
methods.description: Handles a new posted notification, updates store, and emits change event.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onNotificationRemoved
methods.description: Handles notification removal, updates store, and emits change event.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.notificationChangedPayload
methods.description: Constructs JSON payloads reflecting notification changes with filtering based on policies.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.refreshActiveNotifications
methods.description: Refreshes the internal notification store based on current notifications.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.StatusBarNotification.toEntry
methods.description: Converts a system StatusBarNotification into a DeviceNotificationEntry.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.serviceComponent
methods.description: Builds a component name for the listener service.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.setNodeEventSink
methods.description: Sets a callback for emitting notification change events.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.recentPackages
methods.description: Establishes and retrieves the list of recent package names.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.isAccessEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the app has notification listener permission.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.snapshot
methods.description: Provides a snapshot of current notifications and status.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.requestServiceRebind
methods.description: Requests the system to rebind the notification listener service.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.executeAction
methods.description: Executes an external command/request for notification actions.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.executeActionInternal
methods.description: Performs an action on a specific notification, such as open, dismiss, or reply.
